factors.description: Electric power contribution increases from 15% to 50% of total power output

Minimum chassis weight decreases from 798 kg to 768 kg
New tire compounds with reduced contact patch area decrease mechanical grip
Sustainable fuel mandates with reduced flow rates emphasize energy efficiency
